input.official_license_statement: Download a copy of the dataset (distributed under the CC BY-SA 4.0 license)

selection.train_doc_id: squad11-train-<zero-based article index>-<zero-based paragraph index>, decimal ASCII
selection.eligible_questions: only qas originally belonging to the fixed selected corpus paragraphs; read id/question, ignore answers
selection.insufficient_or_oversize: stop; do not change seed/count/replace queries or documents
selection.preparation_observation: No ranking, scoring, model or fit; input/source selection already prepared before this action protocol.

hypothesis.meaning: saved validation paired candidate TF-IDF cosine minus baseline BM25 mean

budget.tools: one primary pair; only if original condition met one saved audit and one final

evaluation.primary: report saved dev/validation metrics and predicate outcome, including all adverse/zero/negative results
evaluation.final: only condition_met original policy audit verified => fixed strategy freeze => at most once original final => original report
evaluation.wait_or_unknown_final: unmeasured / None; no final ranking/scoring and no automatic staged report
evaluation.final_selection_bias: final is conditional on validation success; not an unbiased independent replication or cross-task benefit proof

recovery.unknown_action: stop under original request; never retry another project or directory
recovery.terminal_replay: no new actions or budgets; preserve bytes and state

limitations: Same public dataset, different official split and fixed paragraph cohort; not a new dataset or cross-dataset generalization.
Selection and download before action registration; no claim of prior non-exposure or blind/sealed evaluation.
S046 used DEV; visible tracked history has no TRAIN execution. Inaccessible historical ledgers remain unknown.
One original question-to-paragraph mapping, not exhaustive relevance or answer quality.
Corpus and query sampling differ from S046; do not compare raw scores as a controlled treatment effect across cohorts.
Native deterministic conditional gate; no model autonomy, statistical significance, OS/sealed isolation or complete Gates claimed.
